NFL DFS Week 3 Picks: Top DraftKings Projections, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, September 27 · 13 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 23, 1:46 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 3 DraftKings main slate: 29.9 DraftKings points at $8,800. He also holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Kenneth Walker III second at 30% for $7,400.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are James Cook III (23.5, $6,900), Jonathan Taylor (21.7, $7,600), Kenneth Walker III (21.5, $7,400) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (21.3, $7,900). James Cook III returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.40 projected points per $1,000. Amon-Ra St. Brown leads the wide receivers at 21.3 for $7,900, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.2 for $8,000, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 15.4 for $6,700.

The 13-game slate runs from a 52.5-point total in BAL at DAL down to 39.5 in SEA at WAS. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 23, 1:46 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 3 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs LAC ($8,000)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.2 DraftKings points at $8,000. That is 1.6 points clear of Patrick Mahomes. The model includes 6.5 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.65 projected points per $1,000, 19th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 38.6, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Patrick Mahomes, KC at MIA ($6,200)

Patrick Mahomes projects 2nd at the position with 19.6 DraftKings points at $6,200. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.16 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 19.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 35.8, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 11.5-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Deshaun Watson, CLE vs CAR ($4,700)

Deshaun Watson projects for 18.2 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.87 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 6.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 33.4, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 2.5-point underdog at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 20 in a game totaled at 42.5.

The model gives him 22.9 carries and 6.0 targets. The salary works out to 3.40 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 29.8 points with a simulated floor of 11.5 and a ceiling of 57.2, and he holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 27.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 23.4 points with a simulated floor of 9.1 and a ceiling of 46.0, and he holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Jonathan Taylor, IND vs HOU ($7,600)

Jonathan Taylor projects 3rd at the position with 21.7 DraftKings points at $7,600, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 3.6 targets. The current projection of 21.7 compares with a saved model baseline of 20.5. The salary works out to 2.86 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Taylor averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 42.1, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 2.5-point underdog at home against Houston, with an implied team total of 20.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.

Aaron Jones Sr. projects for 19.4 DraftKings points at $5,900, which works out to 3.28 points per $1,000 of salary. The current projection of 19.4 compares with a saved model baseline of 21.1. Across 10,000 simulations Jones averaged 19.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 37.4, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Minnesota is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 22 in a game totaled at 42.5.
